description:
Create snippets of text for support responses, sales outreach, or even common emails and save them in TextExpander.


What's new in TextExpander 8.4.7
Note: Conditional Sections is in Phased Rollout and being enabled for accounts in stages. Contact support@textexpander.com to request earlier access.
Improvements
- Adding a branch to a conditional section places the cursor inside the new branch so you can type right away.
Bug fixes
- Conditional section branches keep their bulleted and numbered list formatting when the snippet expands. Snippets already saved without that formatting are repaired when you open them.
- Pressing Backspace on a conditional or optional section marker now asks for confirmation, keeping the marker and its matching pair intact.
